summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of BRUNO Digital Business Card Application. All requested features are working correctly: i18n (ES/EN) with persistence, Grid/List view toggle on Feed and Dashboard, Create Card page with all 6 card types including CURRICULUM with specific fields, Image upload areas, Pricing page with 4 plans and Stripe checkout buttons, and glassmorphism/bubble design effects.
critical_code_review_comments: Language context implementation is well-structured with localStorage persistence and browser auto-detection
All 6 card types (Personal, Corporate, Business, Places, Guardian, Curriculum) are properly implemented
CURRICULUM type correctly shows all 5 specific sections: Experience, Education, Skills, Languages, Documents
Glassmorphism CSS effects are properly applied with backdrop-blur and bubble animations
Grid/List view toggle works on both Feed and Dashboard pages
Pricing page displays 4 subscription plans plus one-time NFC purchases with Stripe checkout integration
seed_data_creation: Used existing test users from previous iteration
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features verified working. Language switcher persists preference in localStorage. Dashboard and Feed both have working Grid/List toggles. CURRICULUM card type shows all 5 specific sections (Experience, Education, Skills, Languages, Documents). Pricing page has 4 plans with Stripe checkout buttons. Glassmorphism effects applied via CSS classes (glass-card, card-bubble-animated, card-hover-lift).
